findings.detail: Investment-schedule structural rows such as industry labels and section labels are being counted as leaves even though they have no position-level fair value cell.

rationale: Class 3 aggregate review. Source anchors reconcile: the filing schedule total at table 6 row 38 is Total Investments fair value 946,318,463, and the fair-value hierarchy total independently reports 946,319 in thousands at table 23 row 5. Actual SOI investment rows carry Fair Value cells, but the schedule also contains non-position structural rows such as industry labels and section labels with no fair-value cell. The B01 failure reports 155/240 leaves with fair_value and 85 residual rows with zero residual fair value, which matches structural row leakage into the leaf denominator rather than a bad source total.
